messages.subject: CEO Office role at Oleria
messages.body:
Hi Jagadeesh,

Your post about the CEO Office role describes strategy and executive business operations that run alongside you. That is close to how I worked at Ola Electric, where I partnered with the CEO and COO on fulfilment operations and owned finished goods inventory end-to-end.

I worked on GTM strategies for multiple products at Ola Electric (BESS, 4680 Cell and multiple new variants launched) while managing production planning and inventory management side by side. I executed multiple strategies and was a notable contributor to increasing serviceability of OLA electric to 70% and, in parallel, decreasing O2D from 30 to 14 days during peak seasons.

I do not have an MBA. I am an IIT Guwahati engineer who has done this kind of work for a year.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Regards
messages.hook: His own post hiring for the CEO Office: strategy and executive business operations, MBA preferred

messages.subject: Chief of Staff, Manufacturing (Chennai)
messages.body:
Hi Rajalakshmi,

Your post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai lists plant performance and business reviews, which is the work I did at Ola Electric. I owned S&OP production planning there, built 3-month rolling production plans, and drove backend production planning for the 4680 cell line, where yield rose from 42% to 67% in two months.

I have about 1.3 years of full-time experience, so if your client needs someone more senior, a quick no is useful. If not, I would like to be considered. Could you tell me what you need from me to take it forward?

Shlok
messages.hook: Her post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai: plant performance and business reviews

messages.subject: Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail
messages.body:
Hi Carbon Trail team,

A LinkedIn jobs roundup listed a remote Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail. I could not find the listing on your site, so I am writing directly.

A fashion brand's footprint is largely decided by its supply chain and inventory, which is where I spent the last year. At Ola Electric, I ran S&OP planning over Rs 200 Cr of inventory and led a pan-India rebalancing of non-moving stock that unlocked 27% working capital. I believe my experience in Supply chain and operations will be useful in S&OP at Carbon Trail.

If the role is open, I would like to be considered.

Regards,
Shlok Agrawal
messages.hook: A LinkedIn jobs roundup (Yash Chitransh, 3 Nov) listed a remote Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail; the listing itself was not found

messages.subject: Founder's Office Generalist at Leucine
messages.body:
Hi Vivek,

Leucine's line that pharma plants still run on paper, Excel and tribal knowledge matches what I saw inside a factory. At Ola Electric I implemented SAP MRP from scratch as Raw Material Manager, which cut stock-outs by 20%, and drove production planning for the 4680 cell line while yield went from 42% to 67% in two months.

Your Founder's Office Generalist role asks for someone who turns shop-floor realities into product requirements. My planning work sat between procurement, suppliers and production, so that translation is familiar.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Shlok

messages.subject: Program Manager, Founder's Office at Sugar.fit

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

messages.subject: EA to COO | Shlok Agrawal
messages.body:

Your post is clear that the EA to the COO at WarpDrive is not an admin job: it means driving initiatives to closure, building dashboards and using AI tools every day. That is close to my last year at Ola Electric, where I partnered with the COO and CEO on fulfilment operations and owned finished goods inventory end to end. Before that, at InsuranceDekho, I built a Flask REST API with a Chrome extension that autofilled forms and cut response times by 40%.

messages.subject: Founder's Office Associate at Ghost Kitchens India
messages.body:
Hi Aryan,

Running Badboy Pizza and the other brands across cloud kitchens, delivery-first concepts and dine-in means every new outlet is a call on demand, stock and cash. I spent the last year on that kind of call at Ola Electric, where I led a pan-India inventory rebalancing based on sales run rate and unlocked 27% working capital.

I would like to be considered for the Founder's Office Associate role at Ghost Kitchens India in Mumbai, field days included. Would 15 minutes this week work, so I can hear what the founders want this person to own first?

messages.subject: Founder's Office - Business Execution Manager
messages.body:
Hi Akash,

Your post asks for one piece of work with a measurable outcome, so here is mine. At Ola Electric I drove backend production planning for the Bharat Cell (4680) and Shakti (BESS) launches, and cell yield improved from 42% to 67% in 2 months. Launches like that are mostly dependency tracking, which is what the PMO seat at GBG does for hub launches.

I would like to be considered for the Business Execution Manager / PMO role, and I am based in Bengaluru. If you see me as a better fit for the Business Analyst seat, I am open to that too. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Shlok
messages.hook: Akash's post asks applicants to name the role and give one example of relevant work with a measurable outcome; the PMO role coordinates hub launches and tracks dependencies

messages.subject: Generalist role at Deccan AI
messages.body:
Hi Vrushali,

Syed's post says Deccan AI, now serving Google DeepMind and Microsoft after its USD 25 million raise, wants generalists who carry a problem on their own across functions. My last year at Ola Electric was that kind of work: I owned S&OP production planning over Rs 200 Cr of inventory and 3-month rolling plans, cutting working capital by 40% in 2.5 months. Before that I was a Codeforces Expert and placed in the top 0.05% of 400,000+ in Flipkart Grid.

I would like to be considered for a generalist role in Hyderabad. Which team is hiring first, so I can speak to its problem?

Shlok

messages.subject: metal card delivery
messages.body:
Hi Kanika,

Since July, a TheCardCompany customer who picks a feature plan in the app also orders a physical metal card. As orders grow, the wait for that card tends to become the part of onboarding people remember.

At Ola Electric I worked with the CEO and COO on fulfilment. A scooter took 32 days from order to delivery; I built the algorithm that groups truck dispatches into lots, and it came down to 14.

I saw the Founder's Office intern post, but I'm past the intern stage. If a full-time Founder's Office hire is on your mind, I can send one page on how I'd look at card delivery. Want me to send it?

Shlok
